before.reason: The complete before span declaration has no spoiler type.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS and paired || delimiters, reach spoiler span rendering through md_html.
after.reason: The new flag enables collection and resolution of paired pipes, and the renderer handles the resulting span. The harness passes input-controlled flags and remaining bytes to md_html.

source_evidence.quote:
#define MD_FLAG_LATEXMATHSPANS              0x1000  /* Enable $ and $$ containing LaTeX equations. */
#define MD_FLAG_WIKILINKS                   0x2000  /* Enable wiki links extension. */
#define MD_FLAG_UNDERLINE                   0x4000  /* Enable underline extension (and disables '_' for normal emphasis). */
#define MD_FLAG_HARD_SOFT_BREAKS            0x8000  /* Force all soft breaks to act as hard breaks. */
#define MD_FLAG_SPOILERS                    0x10000 /* Enable ||hidden text|| spoiler spans. */

claims.reason: Spoiler spans were absent before and are selectable with the same old harness after the change.
